title: A Promise for the Tide
author: Wendell Okonkwo
blurb: Lior Crane, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
